description: A `risky(n)?` arm body of a decl-position `match` propagates: on an error the enclosing `!` function returns it (the caller's `!{}` sees `Boom`), and the write after the `match` does not run.
rationale: §19.5.1 `propagation-expr ::= expression '?'` is an expression, and §18.2 `arm-body ::= expression | block-body`, so `.A :> risky(n)?` is a legal arm. §19.5.2: "If the result is an error variant, `?` causes the enclosing function to return that error variant immediately." impl#1 emitted the `?` literally (`= f(n) ?;`, E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC — dpa-068 D4).
